scope: Counterexamples and assumption-boundary witnesses; not a count of false original theorems

witnesses.witness: O and -O share four even invariants, chi15=+-20640382199000.
Axisymmetric Q and O have an SO(2) stabilizer; equivariant full frame would require h=I.
Q=diag(1,2,-3), rational O and -O have equal powers/bispectra and kappa=+-857280; only four quadratic/cubic scalar generators.
Constant base kernel is not characteristic; one-sided averaging of (1+x)(1+y) gives non-symmetric 1+y.
Uniaxial control attains 6 J^3 and the universal upper bound is 6 J^3, so 16/sqrt(3) is not sharp.
Linear allowed unit ball versus actual solution {0}: one-sided zero remainder but Hausdorff distance1.
Orthogonal O_perp:Q=0 leaves beta uniquely equal M^-1(O:Q); unrestricted intrinsic O is different.
F=(1-n_z)^2 is nonnegative but not strictly positive and cannot have finite boost with SPD M.
Channel gain error and spectral contamination can both create frequency incoherence, so its physical cause is not uniquely identified.
All equal scores give p=1, not a uniform finite rank distribution.
Same intensity with arbitrary small high-l polarization has unchanged T and independent Q/U.
Bonferroni or joint calibration remains valid under arbitrary shared-seed dependence; paired contrasts are not necessary.
Unknown covariate shift with unchanged Y|X is missing from the alleged exhaustive trichotomy.
delta_-eps vs delta_+eps: W1=2eps but threshold-probability gap1.
Bounded C=[0,1],z=2: Gaussian GLRT score3, squared projection1.
Equivalent theta_a/theta_b with p_a=U,p_b=1-U: point coverage1-alpha, whole-set coverage1-2alpha.
Data-derived MES set with separate failure probability beta requires alpha+beta, with disjoint failures achieving the bound.
E1=E2=2 Bernoulli(1/2): marginal mean1 but product mean2.
Select max of 2*I(U<1/2),2*I(U>=1/2) after observing current outputs: selected mean2.
Symmetric retention Xi>1/2 gives valid selected-query ranks despite data-dependent selection.
Scores (U,1-U,1-U) have identical uniform marginals but P(p0<=1/3)=1/2.
Strictly decreasing transform of (1,2,3) reverses upper ranks unless tails are swapped.
Nondegenerate Gaussian Y has positive density near0, hence E(Y^-2)=infinity and transformed-mean constant-temperature estimator converges to0 a.s.
N=2 iid Uniform scores: P(p0<=1/2 | labelled reference X1=x)=1-x, so unconditional validity is not uniform conditional validity for each fixed reference.
